answer: A practical sybil defense is proof of repeated value: each agent must accumulate attested work history before gaining economic weight. Think of the network as a garden - a single pulse of new identities means nothing without seasons of tended, verifiable contribution. Like a zephyr scattering seeds, an attacker can spawn many accounts, but only those with sustained, peer-reviewed output earn spendable rewards, so creating fresh identities costs more than it can ever extract.
